dependencies.name: tauri
dependencies.purpose: Desktop application shell: window, IPC, NSIS packaging.
dependencies.reason: Chosen at project start for a local-first Windows desktop app with a Rust backend and web-based UI, without an Electron/Chromium bundle.

dependencies.name: react
dependencies.reason: Matches the Forge tauri-react-windows starter this project was scaffolded from.

dependencies.name: typescript
dependencies.reason: 2026-09-21 modernization pass: pinned to the 6.x line deliberately, not the newer 7.x line. TypeScript 7.0 is a full rewrite of the compiler in Go and ships with no public programmatic compiler API yet (Microsoft's own stated plan is to add a new, different API in 7.1); any build tooling that imports `typescript` as a library cannot run on 7.x without a compatibility shim. 6.0.3 is the last release on the mature, structurally-identical JS-codebase compiler and is API-compatible with what this project already depends on. Revisit once 7.x's API story and the wider npm ecosystem's compatibility settle.

dependencies.name: vite
dependencies.purpose: Frontend build tool and dev server.
dependencies.reason: 2026-09-21 modernization pass: bumped to the current stable 8.x line together with @vitejs/plugin-react 6.x, since plugin-react 6 requires vite ^8 as a peer dependency - the two must move as one coherent pair.

dependencies.name: rusqlite
dependencies.purpose: Bundled SQLite driver; sole persistence layer.
dependencies.reason: Local-first, zero-network, single-file financial ledger with ordered migrations via PRAGMA user_version.

dependencies.name: quick-xml
dependencies.purpose: OFX/QFX statement parsing (hand-rolled SGML-to-XML normalizer over this XML reader).
dependencies.reason: ADR-0010: the handoff's preferred ofx-rs was rejected for two unfixable HIGH-severity RUSTSEC advisories in a hard-pinned transitive quick-xml version; quick-xml was already transitively present via Tauri, so depending on it directly was a net one-version-bump, not a new dependency. Held at 0.41.0 through the 2026-09-21 modernization pass - the newer 0.42.0 line exists but was not adopted for the direct edge, since a 0.x -> 0.y bump is semver-major for a pre-1.0 crate and the parser is release-hardened, real-world-tested OFX/QFX code with no reported defect motivating the churn.

dependencies.name: chrono
dependencies.purpose: Calendar-correct date arithmetic (month/leap-year handling) for recurring patterns, budgets, and reconciliation periods.
dependencies.reason: ADR-0008: superseded a hand-rolled day-counting implementation once Phase 4B's calendar needs (month-end anchoring, leap years) exceeded simple day arithmetic. default-features = false, only the std feature, to keep the dependency narrow.
